1.name: Ending 1: Pathfinder
1.desc: When you lead the way, no one behind you will ever lose their path
1.text:
You spent <color=#FFAF2C>more than expected</color> in personnel and time, but at least achieved a decent ending... The abnormal expansion of the Companion Hollow has gradually been contained. All that remains now is for you to clean up the aftermath.

You will never abandon the victims lost within the Hollow, because deep down you know the only secret to a legendary Proxy never losing their way is to <color=#FFAF2C>never</color> let go of a single hand reaching out to you.

And so, you accept one rescue commission after another, like attempting to locate a dark, unlit planet adrift in the endless cosmos.

...But those are long, remarkable tales for another time.

2.name: Ending 2: Devoured
2.desc: Let sadness and regret be your driving force, and begin a new round of struggle
2.text:
You feel like you've been falling off a cliff ever since that day when the Hollow Disaster nearly swallowed half the city.

As a Proxy, you connect everyone inside and outside the Hollows.
<color=#FFAF2C>When your rope snaps because you weren't careful enough, everyone else falls with you.</color>

As you clean up the aftermath, you wonder which fleeting opportunity you might have missed... then you decide to stop searching for an answer, because it's meaningless.
The Hollows are chaotic and disordered; you never needed to understand them, just to conquer them.

Only, it has to be done before the entire city collapses.

3.name: Ending 3: In the Name of Legend
3.desc: Earn glory by saving the city and clear your tarnished name
3.text:
Welcome back, <color=#FFAF2C>Phaethon</color>!
You may wonder why such a legendary title can once again be safely spoken in the light of day... but the truth is clear: you brought down the Hollow where the Exaltists dark plot was brewing, restoring peace, prosperity, and safety to New Eridu. Such an accomplishment is enough to erase every stigma.

As for <color=#FFAF2C>"The Secret of the Old Capital's Fall"</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>"The Missing Teacher"</color>... forget about them! Not all truths need to be revealed at once, besides, you wouldn't want to work overtime every day.

Now, your tasks are to return to the video store on Sixth Street and handle the flood of membership applications.
Then upgrade your favorite Supreme Assistant with more advanced smart devices — you won't have to worry about electric bills anymore, as people will be fighting to cover your expenses.
Finally, attend news interviews and promotional shoots with your loved ones.
...Oh, almost forgot! You'll need to take calls from TOPS Alliance headhunters, only to casually decline their high-paying offers, claiming you just want an ordinary life.

In the future, you'll continue your journey to save the city. But whenever you return to the video store, you'll hear all of Sixth Street whispering your name:

<color=#FFAF2C>The Legendary Proxy — "Phaethon"</color>.

1000501.name: The Fairy's Hint
1000501.desc:
"Master, welcome to the <color=#FFAF2C>Hollow</color>."
Fairy's voice rings in your ears as usual.

"For the sake of your mental and physical well-being, please remain calm, regardless of what you encounter, as I have already screened out potentially <color=#FFAF2C>disturbing scenes</color>."
"And don't celebrate, either, since what's been screened could just as well be <color=#FFAF2C>thrilling scenes</color>."

"Please note: This simulation will use Agents' real appearances, but the story that follows is generated from your choices, combined with Fairy's detailed understanding of human society. <color=#FFAF2C>If it's a little off, it'll be better next time</color>."

1000601.name: If We Answer the Call for Help
1000601.desc:
The performance in the Hollow is over! The Agents watched the Marionettes' final bow regretfully, trying to piece together the untold story behind the ballet sisters of urban legend.
But you quickly stopped them — there will always be regrets in the Hollow, and the living can only embrace their sorrow and move forward.

After some thought, you spoke up to comfort everyone.
"If you miss them, just head to the <color=#FFAF2C>Notorious Hunt</color>. It happens every week."
...Though everyone looked a little puzzled, your words did the trick, and you all kept moving forward.

1000602.name: If We Answer the Call for Help
1000602.desc:
"H—Help... help us!" A cry for help echoes from the Hollow, a sound you're all too familiar with. You know well that behind the Mist lies either a tragic victim or an unknown danger.

"Please briefly describe the crisis you're facing?" you shout into the depths of the Hollow.

"It's dangerous ahead. That Ethereal..." the reply comes quickly, accompanied by a weak cough, "it keeps repeating."
"Oh? And what exactly does it repeat?"

"<color=#FFAF2C>...May the Creator refine me!</color>"

1000603.name: If We Answer the Call for Help
1000603.desc:
...there are many Ethereals who might repeat those words.

You've come to believe the injured person's account, but you still have an important mission and can't afford any more delays.

Will you rescue the injured person right in front of you...
Or stick to the plan, press forward, and search for the core of this Companion Hollow?

—Your choice here will cause the future of <color=#FFAF2C>STORY 2</color> to branch...

choice.name: Eliminate the Hollow first
choice.desc: Score over 28,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 01

1000604.name: If We Answer the Call for Help
1000604.desc:
A hail of bullets came straight at you.
The ones you rescued weren't victims, but a group of vicious Hollow Raiders who had just lost a fierce battle against the Exaltists in the Hollow. They fled and see you as nothing more than a walking supply cache.

Too bad they were wrong! You and your Agents are the most terrifying — no, the most <color=#FFAF2C>righteous</color> force in the Hollow. They got what they deserved and had to hand over all their Supplies to you.

"'What to Eat in the Hollow: The Ethereal Cookbook'... what is this? Better toss it. And... an autographed photo of the Angels of Delusion, I'll hold onto that for now. Let's see what else... ah, now this is useful!"

—You obtained a <color=#FFAF2C>Finishing Shot Pistol</color>. Take it with you to handle the next crisis.

1000605.name: If We Answer the Call for Help
1000605.desc:
You chose to stick to the original plan. As an experienced Proxy, you know better than to trust anyone in the Hollow.

...Sure enough, it's that caution that ensures you always come out on top in the Hollow! After discovering your refusal to walk into their trap, the Exaltist followers who were pretending to be injured began gathering in the Mist, surrounding you.

To your shock, you spot a number of familiar figures lying in the distance... Public Security Officers you've crossed paths with before.
They got caught in the Exaltist plot, and turned into test subjects to measure the Sacrifices' strength... and you can never forgive such an act.

—You've gained <color=#FFAF2C>"Feelings of Rage"</color>, only vengeance can quell this burning fury.

1000701.name: The Abyss Stares Back
1000701.desc:
You defeated that eerie arm-shaped Sacrifice and tried to get more intel from its deranged mind... but just as you opened your mouth, the pistol you obtained earlier began strangely. Its dark barrel automatically aimed at the Sacrifice's head, the trigger pulled, and everything in front of you exploded.

You ran your hand over the pistol and gleaned more information before it vanished.

"<color=#FFAF2C>This is a pistol that automatically delivers a killing blow. It always jams when you need it most, and its only purpose is to finish off villains after they're down, silencing them before they reveal any spoilers.</color>"

You took another careful look and found there was another page.

1000702.name: The Abyss Stares Back
1000702.desc:
"Special note from the <color=#FFAF2C>Supreme Assistant</color>: The data collected is insufficient to complete the deduction. For a seamless experience, random plot logic will be auto-generated. If you're unhappy with the result, change it up next time."

You accepted this explanation.
All in all, you dealt with a major incident in the Hollow and can now move forward.

1000703.name: The Abyss Stares Back
1000703.desc:
You continued forward and encountered a <color=#FFAF2C>Prophet</color> in the Hollow, who claims to be a <color=#FFAF2C>traitor</color> to the Exaltists.
He can foretell a message about your future, provided you offer him satisfactory payment.

"I crave chargrilled supercritical Ether hearts, or slow-aged Thracian... Fine, I'll settle for chilled Netherblossom salad... You don't have that either? Let's compromise then — how about something sweet? A Doppelganger mille-feuille, perhaps?"

You've never heard of these dishes, but you managed to come up with a solution.

—Your choice here will cause the future of <color=#FFAF2C>STORY 3</color> to branch...

choice.name: Tell him you've defeated an Ethereal with massive arms
Threaten him with force
choice.desc: Score over 28,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 02

1000704.name: The Abyss Stares Back
1000704.desc:
"I recognize him, that's Sacrifice Bringer! He carried out the Creator's orders brilliantly! Now that you've defeated him, I can savor the taste of his lingering regret... truly delicious!"

The Prophet hurried off to feast, but before leaving, had just enough time to tell you some bad news.

"The <color=#FFAF2C>overseer</color> is watching you. Hide your precious <color=#FFAF2C>memories</color> well, lest they one day turn their blade against you."

You believed this prophecy and continue deeper into the Hollow... and to your surprise, the prophecy came true.

1000705.name: The Abyss Stares Back
1000705.desc:
As the most <color=#FFAF2C>righteous</color> force in the Hollow, you and your Agents never bow to evil threats. Thus you resorted to certain tactics, of the kind that AI would automatically block, forcing the unknown prophet to speak, seething with rage yet powerless to resist.

"The <color=#FFAF2C>Overseer</color>'s gaze is cast upon the city, and will not stop until <color=#FFAF2C>your important companion is taken away</color>."

You question this prophecy and continue deeper into the Hollow without looking back... but to your surprise, the prophecy comes true.

1000801.name: Shadow of the Past
1000801.desc:
You and your Agents <color=#FFAF2C>furiously</color> defeated the arm-type Sacrifice that was once human, then <color=#FFAF2C>furiously</color> tried to find more intelligence from its broken body. You <color=#FFAF2C>furiously</color> reached out, but ultimately lost control and threw multiple Ether Power Canisters at it.

The massive explosion cleared away all evidence, along with your <color=#FFAF2C>rage</color>.

As you calm down, you begin to think.
"Fairy, you over-simulated all of our emotions, inflating the Agents' stats beyond their limit, until they completely <color=#FFAF2C>lost control</color>."
"Master, as you sometimes ask to 'skip' the story, I created certain logic on my own so you could move faster to the next plot node. If it doesn't suit you, feel free to change it next time."

You accept this explanation and move forward.

1000802.name: Shadow of the Past
1000802.desc:
With every step forward, the Hollow's unusual nature grows more apparent.
Murky Miasma, hallucinations, high concentrations of Ether, fallen victims scattered along the way, and even traces of military combat operations left behind.

"What on earth happened here? Is it really just highly active Ethereals deep in the Hollows?"

Your thoughts are cut short by the sound of gunfire. Looking up, you can faintly make out a squad of soldiers in <color=#FFAF2C>old military uniforms</color>, emerging like phantoms from the far end of the path.

Is this a hallucination... or reality?

—Your choice here will cause the future of <color=#FFAF2C>STORY 4</color> to branch...

choice.name: This is an illusion caused by the Miasma
Launch a direct attack on them
choice.desc: Score over 28,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 02

1000803.name: Shadow of the Past
1000803.desc:
You judge the shadowy figures in the Mist to be mere illusions brought on by the Miasma. In the Hollows, even sights and sounds can be deceiving.
And behind those deceptions, a far more terrifying presence surely lurks.

"Proxy, look. The sky... it's covered in <color=#FFAF2C>crimson fog</color>."
That presence is drawing closer to you.

1000804.name: Shadow of the Past
1000804.desc:
An intense sense of foreboding stirs within you! You firmly believe the tainted phantoms of the past truly exist, and that something far greater is concealed behind them.

You and your Agents launch a direct attack against them... The result is clear — they were indeed beings formed from Miasma. If they can be discovered, they can be destroyed.

But such commotion will undoubtedly draw attention from the powers behind the scenes — the Exaltist followers have found this place.

You have no choice but to deal with them as well — your practiced skill making you look every bit the veteran Hollow Raider.
And when you rifle through their belongings... you appear all the more like one.

—You obtained <color=#FFAF2C>"Clothes commonly worn by Exaltist Worshippers"</color>.

Disguised, you slip past any Exaltists along the way and reach the altar's depths where the overseer waits...
Seizing the moment, you launch your attack!

1000901.name: Support Request
1000901.desc:
The Exaltists blocking your path are defeated, but the Ether concentration in the Hollow remains just thick. You recall the prophecy you trusted so deeply, convinced that something far more terrifying, some <color=#FFAF2C>Miasma-forged creation</color>, awaits ahead. It feeds on ill-fated memories, powered by Miasma, to give a twisted rebirth to tragic souls already lost... regardless of their own will.
You let out a heavy sigh... having to stand against someone you once knew is something you can never steel yourself for.

"If you can't bring yourself to deal with someone you know, let's <color=#FFAF2C>switch</color> opponents."
You hear some strange murmuring.

"We help each other out — taking down each other's targets, serving as one another's alibis, never giving anyone reason to doubt us... Truth is, some folks have long overstayed their welcome."
...Can't be. This must be a <color=#FFAF2C>hallucination from the Miasma</color>. There isn't a conspiracy unfolding here.

At the very least, you come away from this talk of "helping each other" with some inspiration for solving ypur problems. If the Hollow's expansion grows more severe, and it becomes too much for your group alone to handle, maybe you can...

—This choice will determine your opponent in the <color=#FFAF2C>"LAST NODE"</color>.

choice.name: Request help from the Supreme Assistant
Contact assistance outside the Hollow
choice.desc: Score over 35,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 03

1001001.name: Bad Omen
1001001.desc:
Sure enough, you run into the mysterious figures of the Exaltists... and with each moment, you feel more certain they are something beyond human. In body and in creed alike, there is no good, no evil, only terrifying fanaticism. What is it they are so devoted to?

"...Taking away your <color=#FFAF2C>precious companions</color>."

You keep recalling that sinister prophecy. The moment you met the Exaltist overseer, half of it had already come true, and the remaining half...

Thinking about this, you decide to check on everyone's safety right away, but time is short, and you only have the chance to make one phone call—

—This choice will determine your opponent in the <color=#FFAF2C>"LAST NODE"</color>.

choice.name: Contact Suibian Temple
choice.desc: Score over 35,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 03

1001101.name: The Will That Should Exist
1001101.desc:
The overseer has fallen, but the dispersing Miasma feels as if it's being guided, surging toward the <color=#FFAF2C>unknown depths</color>.

You speculate that from the moment they gave up their identity as humans, the "death" of the individual might have ceased to matter.

What truly defines their existence is a secret, a power, a <color=#FFAF2C>long-term plan</color> unknown to all.
And you've merely scratched the surface.

1001102.name: The Will That Should Exist
1001102.desc:
"We have to stop the Miasma from gathering further. At this rate, the Hollow's expansion will surpass the Zenless Limit."

There may not be enough time to investigate why the Miasma is growing.
"<color=#FFAF2C>But there's still something we can do—</color>"

The excess anomalous Ether that once scattered across the Companion Hollow, unable to dissipate, now gathers in one place. There's bound to be a <color=#FFAF2C>Core</color> there.

"Destroy it, or be devoured by the Hollow... the decisive moment is here."
But the Hollow's "will" seems to have sensed this, and the demons formed from Miasma once again stand in your way...

1001103.name: The Will That Should Exist
1001103.desc:
"Proxy, leave this to us."

You're pulled into a strong <color=#FFAF2C>embrace</color> from your most trusted Agent.

"Keep going forward and find that Core... We'll stay alive, come find you, and then we'll escape the Hollow together."

—This choice will determine your opponent in the <color=#FFAF2C>"LAST NODE"</color>.

choice.name: Advance alone in search of the Hollow's "core"
choice.desc: Score over 35,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 03

1001201.name: Tribute
1001201.desc:
You brought down the overseer, but the thrill of victory is immediately drowned out by the overwhelming sight ahead — an overflow of Miasma streams endlessly into the Hollow's uncharted depths.

"We have to <color=#FFAF2C>stop</color> the Miasma from gathering further. At this rate, the Hollow's expansion will surpass the Zenless Limit."

Looks like the Exaltists' influence reaches far beyond just here... You don your disguise once again and investigate in the direction of the disturbance.

1001202.name: Tribute
1001202.desc:
You have witnessed a truly horrifying sight.
Countless streams of Miasma flow in reverse, swirling and mutating, gathering until it giving birth to a fabricated form — the fallen overseer gradually <color=#FFAF2C>resurrects</color> in a bloody, grotesque shape... revealing her true form!

Even with her honor in tatters, she stubbornly clings to her old path... until, in the end, she finds herself moving against every companion.

She has also noticed your presence, though she has yet to uncover who you really are.
As disguised followers, you must, like other fanatics, willingly <color=#FFAF2C>offer something</color> to temporarily gain her trust and find an opportunity to get close to her...

—This choice will determine your opponent in the <color=#FFAF2C>"LAST NODE"</color>.

choice.name: Offer up your flesh and blood
Surrender your memories
choice.desc: Score over 35,000 in the [Final] stage of BATTLE 03
